claim: Patchline ships an award-readiness dossier scored against published best-paper and best-artifact rubrics. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the award-readiness dossier claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make award-readiness-dossier-2-gate`.
